title: Finding help in Celerp
summary: Open the help for the screen you are on, search every help page, or ask Celerp AI in your own language.

steps.text: On any screen, click {help} in the top bar. {here} lists the help pages written for that screen.
To look further, open the help pages and type a few words into {search}. With nothing typed, {browse} lists every page, grouped by the module it belongs to.
Help pages are written in English, with button and menu names shown in your language. To ask a question in your own words and language, use {ask}. Its answers list the help pages they came from.
